summary: ReportWizardGenerator is a report generation module for HSPnet, featuring localization (English and French), dynamic column mapping, and robust validation. It maps internal data attributes to display column titles for reports in both languages, covers user and placement details, and handles numerous data fields related to students, instructors, supervisors, placements, and compliance. The workflow includes validating parameters, preparing mappings, and generating reports.
purpose: To generate formatted reports with localized column titles from HSPnet data sources, ensuring accurate, readable outputs based on input XML data files and specified parameters.

workflows.name: Generate Report
steps: Validate all input parameters (dataFilePath, filePath, reportHeader, reportName, outputFormat, IsUsingDefaultLocale)
Build column title mapping for default ('colTitle') and alternate ('colTitleAlt') locales
Instantiate Report object with report parameters
Set report titles, column mappings, and header values
Check locale setting and apply correct language
Return error code -1 if parameters are invalid
Call report.Generate(dataFilePath, filePath) to output report

business_rules: Column titles are mapped for both English and French locales.
Parameters must not be null; otherwise, report generation fails.
validations: Reject report generation if any required parameter is null.
Validate locale (IsUsingDefaultLocale) to determine which column mapping to use.
system_behavior: Generates reports with mapped column headers according to locale.
Returns 1 if report generation is successful, -1 otherwise.
dependencies: Uses XML data file as input.
Depends on correct mapping of column titles (colTitle and colTitleAlt).
exceptions: Returns -1 if parameters (dataFilePath, filePath, reportName, outputFormat, IsUsingDefaultLocale) are invalid.
